title: 12 Honcho keeps moving higher with the release of his recent track “Come Down”
htmlContent:
Emerging music star 12 honcho is a talented rapper and songwriter who has climbed the steepest of steps to get to where he is today. His zeal and passion for music have been the backbone of all his successes in the music scene. The talented rapper gives his all in releasing his latest track, "Come Down."

12 honcho on his recent song "Come Down" delivers a good street rap with incredible melodies to spice it all up. He gives you that infectious energy that instantly engages you and has you on the edge of your seat waiting to see what he does next, on a record that doesn't disappoint for a second.
